review.verbatim_critique:
[D0.5.G cold referee] delivered tier=subfield below novelty_target=field (floor=field). The note proves uniform Gaussian approximation, feasible studentization, asymptotic coverage, root-N confidence-set diameter, N^{-1} squared risk, and matching rate lower bounds, but only for the exact stationary Gaussian Matérn-one-half, no-nugget class in dimensions one and two. The framing is faithful about that scope and about certified computation remaining open; it does not falsely present the attainable critical value as effectively computable or the upper theorem as transferring to broader spatial models. The lower bound comes from the regular independent A=0 subexperiment and therefore matches the rates without establishing that vanishing cross-tail adaptation creates a distinct minimax difficulty. The paper score is constrained by the narrow parametric model, the absence of a certified implementation or substantive application, and the compressed treatment of load-bearing arbitrary-design covariance-remainder and quadratic-form CLT bounds. [D0.5.G projected paper-score gate: paper_score_ceiling 7.1 < 7.4, so the graded tier 'field' is capped at 'subfield'. The score assesses the delivered research package without credit for unfinished work.]

review.verbatim_critique:
[D0.5.G cold referee] delivered tier=subfield below novelty_target=field (floor=field). The note proves uniform root-N profile inference and matching length and risk rates only for a tightly specified Gaussian, stationary, no-nugget Matérn model on quasi-uniform designs in dimensions one and two. The converse matches rates but comes from the regular independent A=0 subexperiment, so it does not establish efficient constants or a sharper nonregular adaptation lower bound. The least-favorable critical value is only an implicit mathematical maximum: the unresolved certified-computation problem prevents the refined interval from being reproducibly implemented, although the conservative chi-square procedure remains available. The advertised county-level application is conditional and contains no delivered diagnostic or empirical analysis, while the framing correctly avoids claiming an upper theorem for broader spatial-confounding classes. [D0.5.G projected paper-score gate: paper_score_ceiling 7.2 < 7.4, so the graded tier 'field' is capped at 'subfield'. The score assesses the delivered research package without credit for unfinished work.]

The delivered results establish uniform root-N inference and matching rate lower bounds on the stated narrow Gaussian Matérn, quasi-uniform, no-nugget class; the headline does not overstate that scope or claim efficient constants.
